subject.title: feat(android): add Wear OS app MVP

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Wear OS companion as a first-party Android app surface now, or keep Wear OS outside core until an owner sponsors a smaller supported path?
rationale: The implementation is a broad new app surface with auth, backup, CI, release, and support implications; automation can identify blockers, but it cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own the product surface.

options.title: Adopt With Android Owner Sponsorship
options.body: Keep this PR open only if an Android/product owner sponsors it and requires the security, CI, rebase, and proof blockers to be fixed before merge.

options.title: Pause For External Or Later Path
options.body: Ask for the Wear companion to stay external or be restarted later as a smaller branch when ownership and release support are clear.

options.title: Close If No Owner Adopts
options.body: If no owner wants to carry the first-party surface, close this branch and invite a fresh narrow PR when product direction changes.

recommendation.title: Adopt With Android Owner Sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if an Android/product owner sponsors it and requires the security, CI, rebase, and proof blockers to be fixed before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to obviyus and he has recent Android app/gateway history, making him the best available routing owner for the adoption decision.
